expectation.note: BYDAY and BYMONTHDAY INTERSECT in RRULE. In cron the same two fields are UNIONed under the Vixie rule — the single clearest semantic incompatibility between the grammars.

normative_evidence.quote: Every 4 years, the first Tuesday after a Monday in November, forever (U.S. Presidential Election day): ==> (1996 9:00 AM EST) November 5;(2000 9:00 AM EST) November 7;(2004 9:00 AM EST) November 2

rationale: The definitive cross-grammar vector: '0 9 2-8 11 2' in cron means the 2nd-8th OR every Tuesday; the same intent in RRULE requires an intersection. A translator that maps fields positionally is wrong by construction.
title: US presidential election day (RFC example: BYDAY+BYMONTHDAY intersection)
